notes: Brooklinen's San Francisco store, named in issue #329, read from the brand's own store list on 2026-09-12. https://www.brooklinen.com/pages/our-stores prints every store's address and hours as plain text, with no schema.org markup, no coordinates and no category for the shop — so the entry publishes none, rather than a guess at what kind of shop it is. Four fetches on 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-12 were identical. The $25 is Brooklinen's own wording — its rewards page reads 'Refer a friend and we’ll gift you 1,000 points to use on your next purchase, and they’ll get $25 off' — and the link in the issue is a live rwrd.io share link. The issue writes that link as `http://`; the same path over https reaches the same Brooklinen page, and that is what the REFERRALS row carries. One row, `brooklinen`, for the one shop.
